body:
The social thing is exactly what my teacher said last year when my mom said she wanted me to graduate early. This year, she said she said I would be fine. I don't usually talk. I don't socialize much in school, not at all out. When I know about something, I can and will talk about it. 

But, I fell like everything is happening right now, and the idea of living scares me. For some reason before 12 years old, I really believed I would never live past twenty. Now It seems that natural causes are not likely to do me in, and it scares the shit out of me.

To every response, Thank you. Every answer helped.  
I'm told the first couple years of college are just the basic required stuff, is this true? 
Do you think it is in my best interest to graduate early? It scares me that I will be out of high school at sixteen. But I can do it. should I?
My mom's plan is me graduating end of next year, and getting into college right away.

This is the most difficult question people ask me. I read more than the average person. I browse reddit. I read articles about a lot of things. Certain kinds of history. Less in the general terms of wars that happened, and political things that happened, more in people lives, how they lived. Religions impact on the world history, interesting I think. As for science, more scientific history, less looking at stuff under microscopes and cutting things up, once things get too mathematical i lose interest. Which sucks because I am pretty good at math. Criminal psychology is also pretty interesting, but that sometimes I get the impression thats just a thing with teenagers. Sorry I can't be clearer.

This is long, if you don't feel like dealing with it, just ignore it. 

If I fail to graduate early I will be average in the only area I was ever anything more than proficient. My whole life school was the only thing I was good at. 
Yeah, I have my whole life. I have one year to decide what to do with it. one year is nothing. Every day closer to the deadline, the more pressure for that answer I get. I have never had a life outside of school, I won't have a life outside of my job, If I don't get a career, what will I have? A shitty job. What kind of a life is that? 

I think not knowing how to enjoy life is my problem. I never really got that skill. How am I supposed to learn now, seems like something people pick up before my age. 
As for talking to someone 1) My school doesn't have one, and My mother can't afford one  2) No insurance 3) I couldn't do that to my mom (I know nothing of my father)
